text: Based on the Earth-observation data, the property in question (ASSET-B) did not have any forest cover (tree cover with >=30% canopy) as of 2020, according to the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset. While there was some tree cover present in the year 2000, subsequent tree-cover loss events have reduced this to zero by the baseline date of December 31, 2020. Therefore, the property appears to be legally compliant regarding forests, as there is no forest cover to be non-compliant about.
